decisions.reason: Premium support sits close to the firm's agency-focused, round-the-clock support identity and costs little to keep, since it is carried by existing service staff, so the option stays worth holding.

The version manager builds on the firm's management tools that cut recurring work, and the 2019 website promotes it as a current highlight, so its value appears to be materializing at low carrying cost.

The data-processing contract tool is distant from the core hosting business, its post-GDPR demand has likely faded, and its upkeep competes with many other options in a broad portfolio, so the option has largely resolved.
Scalable agency hosting is central to the firm's strategy and was featured on the home page, so it is a core growth bet worth further commitment rather than a speculative option.
